steps.content:
Welcome to GBBT Bank! Before proceeding, please take a moment (or preferably several unnecessary moments) to carefully, thoroughly, and absolutely not skim the following Terms & Conditions.

1. Ownership of Deposits
By creating an account, you acknowledge, understand, and dramatically pretend to understand that any funds deposited into GBBT Bank legally, morally, spiritually, emotionally, cosmically, and astrologically become the property of GBBT Bank.

Just kidding.

Probably.

2. Nature of the Application
GBBT Bank is a parody application created for entertainment, amusement, educational experimentation, and occasional mild confusion.

This application does not process real money, real loans, real investments, real banking services, or real financial advice.

3. Account Responsibilities
You are responsible for maintaining your account credentials, passwords, enchanted artifacts, sacred relics, and any other magical objects used to access your account.

4. Service Availability
GBBT Bank makes no guarantees regarding uptime, downtime, lunchtime, snack breaks, emotional stability, or the alignment of Mercury.

5. Free Transfers Policy
Free transfers for our LGBTQIA+ family, always. 🌈

6. Refund Policy
There are absolutely no refunds on sass.

7. Accuracy of Information
If something appears suspicious, impossible, or unusually intelligent, please assume it is a feature until proven otherwise.

8. Limitation of Liability
GBBT Bank shall not be held liable for confusion, spontaneous laughter, existential crises, emotional damage caused by dad jokes, or excessive reading of terms and conditions.

9. User Conduct
Users agree not to exploit bugs, start financial cults, claim ownership of the moon, or bribe support with cookies.

10. Final Acknowledgment
By tapping I Agree, you confirm this is a parody application, understand that no real money is being handled, and possess a functioning sense of humor.

If you scrolled all the way down without reading, congratulations. You have successfully completed the traditional Terms & Conditions experience.
